name: Stock Entry Detail-no_of_bags
label: No. of Bags
description: Bags in this row. Counted apart from quintals in the Bag Ledger.

name: Warehouse-operating_unit
label: Operating Unit
description: Leave empty for the shared physical warehouse of a location (the standard: Raw and Boiled share it). Only the older per-unit warehouses name a unit.

name: Warehouse-physical_location
label: Physical Location
description: The physical site (e.g. SSPP GODOWN). Used to total stock per site without double counting.

name: Batch-operating_unit
label: Operating Unit
description: Raw/Boiled unit that owns the stock of this batch. Stock in a shared physical warehouse is attributed by it.

name: Stock Entry-transfer_kind
label: Transfer Kind
options:
Physical Transfer (owner unchanged)
Ownership Transfer (location unchanged)
description: Physical: same owner, new location. Ownership: new owner, same location, documented separately.
